certification.name: Social Links OSINT Certification Program Level 1
certification.description: Vendor program on OSINT investigation with Social Links products in five modules (social media, messengers, niche platforms, advanced features, corporate sources), each followed by a test. The certificate is issued after all tests are passed and is valid for three years.
certification.currency_note: Price not published; enrolment through Social Links (customer success manager or osint@sociallinks.io)
